subject: Emotions
title: Betrayal and Broken Trust
description: A short lesson to help you apply Betrayal and Broken Trust.

hook.text: Discovering a partner's affair feels like a physical blow. Betrayal is surprise aimed at your deepest assumptions.

buildup.text: Jennifer Freyd coined 'betrayal trauma'—the damage when someone you depend on violates your trust.

discovery.text: Betrayal hurts more than loss because it disrupts your model of reality. You trusted, and the model was wrong.

twist.text: People often forgive strangers faster than loved ones. The closer the relationship, the sharper the surprise.

climax.text: Recovery from betrayal requires rebuilding prediction: learning to trust again without denying that trust can fail.

punchline.text: Betrayal doesn't break the heart. It breaks the model.
